title: The Hat Seller
summary: After a long day of work, a hat seller rests under a tree, not knowing that a family of monkeys lives in its branches. The curious monkeys climb down and take all the hats from his bag. How will the hat seller trick the monkeys and get his hats back?
pages: One day, a hat seller walked to a village to sell his hats.
After walking for a long time, he got tired.
So he sat down under a tree to rest.
He was so tired that very soon he fell asleep.
While he slept, a troop of monkeys watched him from up in the tree.
They climbed down from the tree to see him up close.

They opened his bag and rummaged through it.
They were excited to find lots of hats in all kinds of colors, just their size.
Soon, every monkey was wearing one of the hats!
The monkeys danced happily in red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple and pink hats.
Suddenly the hat seller rolled over in his sleep, and all the monkeys ran back up the tree.
When he woke up a few moments later, the monkeys watched and waited.
The hat seller checked his bag. He was very sad to find that the bag was empty. All his hats were gone.

Then he looked up and saw the monkeys wearing his hats!
At first he was surprised. But then he got angry.
He thought and thought about how to get his hats back from the monkeys.
Then he took off his own hat and threw it straight at the monkeys.
The monkeys thought the hat seller was trying to hit them, and they got angry.
So the monkeys took off the hats they were wearing and threw them at the hat seller, one after another.

The hat seller gathered up all his hats and put them in his bag.
The monkeys stared at the hat seller in wonder, and he went off to sell his hats, laughing all the way.
